name: hazel_weir_central_procedural_graph
description: Enterprise-grade procedural execution graph featuring proactive land scaling, continuous late-game fast-crop rotations through day 29, and optimized town shop arbitrage to maximize 10-hand throughput.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, land capacity, and oracle market signals.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Blocks capital expenditure and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Unlocks shops early and preemptively fulfills high-multiplier contracts (Carrots, Tomatoes, Strawberries, Eggs) before open market disposal.

nodes.name: Shed Headroom Relief
nodes.description: Prevents silent 100/100 harvest discards by clearing low-margin non-feed inventory at fair prices when shed approaches true capacity.

nodes.name: Land & Production Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus operational profits into land parcel expansion during early/mid game so the 10-hand workforce operates on 25+ plots without idle congestion.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities immediately before high-confidence opponent market gluts collapse prices.

nodes.name: High-Yield Crop & Market Synchronization
nodes.description: Directs seed budgeting and field planting toward high profit-per-hour crops, dynamically shifting to ultra-fast carrots on days 28-29 for terminal harvest extraction.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines (planting, watering, feeding livestock, harvesting) using available action slots.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases (BUY_SEED, BUY_ANIMAL, BUY_LAND, redundant HIRE); enforce emergency sales of non-feed inventory at hour >= 20; schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 2); do not rely solely on low-value fertilizer sales to cover payroll deficits.

attributes.condition: (has_unlocked_shops and town_shop_demand_available) or (can_unlock_shop and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due + 400.0 and day <= 24)
attributes.guidance: Unlock town shops early when surplus allows; fulfill town shop contracts immediately from shed inventory to lock in 2x-3x price multipliers regardless of cash level.
attributes.pitfalls: Never block town shop contract fulfillment due to low cash—shop sales inject immediate liquidity; avoid unlocking new shops after day 24 when remaining days cannot amortize unlock costs.

attributes.guidance: Evict lowest-margin non-feed inventory (fertilizer, surplus wheat above reserve, raw wool) at market price >= 0.50 * base_price; cancel pending buy orders to free order slots; route eligible goods to town shops before market dumping.
attributes.pitfalls: Never liquidate high-multiplier town shop crops or livestock feed wheat below reserve; do not dump items below 0.50 * base_price unless on terminal day 30.

attributes.condition: net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due + land_parcel_cost + 350.0 and day <= 22 and land_parcels < 4
attributes.guidance: Acquire additional land parcels progressively to expand active crop plots from 9 up to 25-36 tiles; ensure all 10 hired hands have continuous planting and watering work instead of idling on cramped plots.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not purchase land after day 22 when crop turnaround cycles cannot recoup the parcel price; never spend land capital if it imperils midnight payroll.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; place batch sell of held commodity before market price drops below marginal cost.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not sell into already collapsed $1.00 markets; do not prematurely liquidate crops that have active town shop demand premiums.

attributes.guidance: Plant Strawberries and Tomatoes on days <= 26; transition exclusively to Tomatoes/Carrots on days 27-28; on day 29, strictly plant 24-hour Carrots to guarantee a final full harvest payout before turn 720.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not plant long-maturing crops (Strawberries/Tomatoes) on day 29 where they will rot unharvested; do not halt planting at day 27—the final carrot cycles generate over $15,000 in end-game cash.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch idle hands to weeds, feeding, watering, and harvest collection in priority order.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not leave crops unwatered for consecutive turns; ensure hands drop carried items before end of turn 717.
